title: elevator with fish wallpaper
content: it was a pretty normal dream in a office type area, kind of the head office of a rich area. i’m not too sure the extent of the significance but it seemed higher than normal. i was walking past the lobby where other were passing through near the main desk. i wandered down the hall for a while past many curves until i went into this elevator that had fish wallpaper. it begin to go down and kept going down and down and the dream quickly turned to a nightmare. i saw loved ones covered in paint and intoxicated. it was like i had descended into hell from this elevator. has anyone else been in an elevator like this? is it generally not a good idea to go into elevators? i’m not too shook about it although it was definitely one of those shared location dreams and i do not have them often.
